environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7.0 application running in a Docker container (mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:7.0) with default filesystem permissions. Container runs as root user. Volume mount maps /app/uploads to host directory. pgBouncer 1.19 in session pooling mode fronting PostgreSQL 15. No filesystem sandboxing or path restrictions applied. The application has write access to the entire container filesystem including /app, /etc, and other sensitive directories.
